div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. F1–F6 are logical record bundles,
expanded on the subsystem sheets. They group existing private stores; they do not assert a shared database. Repeated actors keep each subsystem interaction local.
